    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid,access_token=access_token)
    songs=pl.get('songs',[])
    durations=[s.get('duration') for s in songs]
    res_list.append({'pid':pid,'title':pl.get('title'),'song_count':len(songs),'durations_sample':durations[:5],'dur_sum':sum(durations)})
print(res_list)

import math
res_list=[
 {'pid': 225,'title': 'Beach Bum Bliss: Ocean Vibes','song_count': 9,'dur_sum': 2032},
 {'pid': 224,'title': 'Cubicle Chronicles: Office Vibes','song_count': 6,'dur_sum': 1526},
 {'pid': 227,'title': 'Family Reunion: Multigenerational Mix','song_count': 7,'dur_sum': 1628},
 {'pid': 226,'title': 'Twilight Tunes: Dusk to Dawn','song_count': 9,'dur_sum': 1898}
]
# compute minutes
for r in res_list:
    r['minutes']=r['dur_sum']/60
    r['minutes_rounded']=int(round(r['minutes']))
print(res_list)
longest=max(res_list,key=lambda x:x['dur_sum'])
print('longest',longest['pid'],longest['title'],longest['dur_sum'],'sec',longest['minutes'],'min rounded',longest['minutes_rounded'])
